name: Rago Fabrication

about:
Rago Fabrication operates from Chandler, Arizona, where it designs and manufactures overlanding and off-road accessories for a wide range of vehicle platforms. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The company's core product lines include MOLLE storage panels, roof racks and ladder systems, off-road bumpers, light brackets, skid plates and rock sliders, on-board air systems, battery and electrical accessories, and bed racks with rail systems. These items are developed for specific vehicle generations spanning Toyota (4Runner, Tacoma, Land Cruiser, Tundra, Sequoia, FJ Cruiser), Lexus (GX 550, GX 460, GX 470), Subaru (Forester, Crosstrek, Outback), Ineos Grenadier, Rivian R1T, Ford Bronco, Chevrolet/GMC Canyon and Colorado, Jeep Gladiator, and Nissan Frontier and Xterra. Rago Fabrication also stocks and sells lighting products from brands such as Rigid Industries, Baja Designs, KC HiLites, Nacho Offroad Lighting, and DV8 Elite Series.

Customers are primarily overlanding enthusiasts, off-road recreational users, and commercial upfitters who need vehicle-specific mounting and protection solutions. The company sells directly through its website and supports a dealer network for broader distribution.

Rago Fabrication emphasizes fit, finish, and attention to detail as its benchmark, stating its products are "designed tough so you can trust they'll stand up to any job." In 2024 the company announced permanent price reductions on core items including MOLLE panels, ditch brackets, and cross bars.
